name: Rotterdam University of Applied Sciences
summary: Rotterdam hogeschool with three English bachelor's: International Business (3-year fast track for IB holders) and WdKA's Fine Art and Graphic Design.

ib.text: The IB Diploma meets the entry level (Dutch HAVO/VWO); no subject requirements. English: exempt if your schooling was entirely in English, otherwise IELTS 6.0, TOEFL iBT 80 or Cambridge 169.

apply.via: Studielink, then OSIRIS Application (WdKA: plus its form)

dates.label: WdKA Round 1 (Fine Art: non-EU applicants only)

programmes.name: International Business
programmes.ib: IB Diploma holders can take the 3-year Fast Track (VWO-level entry) after an intake interview with the Fast Track coordinator.
programmes.about: Business, languages and professional skills in three learning lines, a specialisation in Marketing, Commerce, Supply Chain or Organisation & Change, and exchange and internships in years 3-4.
programmes.selectionNote: Not selective: meet the requirements and you are admitted. The 3-year Fast Track adds a study check and an intake interview you must pass.

programmes.name: Fine Art
programmes.ib: WdKA remote entrance exam (portfolio, home assignments, questionnaire, short video); limited places. EU applicants apply in the March round.
programmes.about: Your own art practice developed through artistic research and concept work across autonomous, social and commercial settings, with a focus on digital technology and public space.
programmes.selectionNote: Remote entrance exam with four assignments; places are limited, so Fine Art has its own rounds. A June round fills a waiting list only.

programmes.name: Graphic Design
programmes.ib: WdKA remote entrance exam (portfolio, home assignments, questionnaire, short video). Three rounds for 2027; apply early.
programmes.about: Shaping information into visual communication with traditional and cross-media techniques, building your own design approach through creative research and critical thinking.
programmes.selectionNote: Remote entrance exam with four assignments. Three rounds; earlier rounds come first, so apply early.
programmes.closesNote: Earlier rounds in January and March

notes: WdKA's other majors (Illustration, Animation, Photography, Fashion and more) are officially Dutch-taught but admit international students, with teaching in English whenever they are in class.
International Business has a language track from year 1: Dutch for non-Dutch speakers, French, German, Spanish, Mandarin, Korean or Japanese.
Before you start, certified copies of your diploma and transcript must reach the university by post or in person by 31 August.
